assumptions: The plugin facade keeps requiring an explicit registered workspaceId. The SPEC-049 T009 CLI views stay as merged. No CLI-vs-MCP baseline exists (SPEC-044 T005 never ran); the surface choice rests on counterfactual analysis.
compatibility: Additive plugin-owned tools under agent-braid-plugin/v0.2 (OD-1); agent-braid-tooling/v0.1 envelopes and v0.2 surface unchanged, no v0.3; SPEC-047 telemetry names per OD-4; rollback by reinstalling the previous plugin release.
domain: Four read-only advisory views over local files in a registered workspace.
execution_contract: None. executionAuthorization is false on every result; no launch, grant, promotion, activation or write.
hypotheses: H1: flat arguments with the schema in the tool description reach at least 8/10 first-attempt validity per host on a held-out set.
observation_contract: What the T003 report, T013 registry and a spec evidence directory say, with the CLI's stated limits; hashes bind bytes, not authenticity.

scenarios.given: this specification, plan, contract and ADR 0043
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: OD-1 to OD-6 are decided or deferred in a dated record and the contract is accepted, amended or rejected.

requirements.text: Owner contract review. The contract, the versioning decision and the publication gate are reviewed by the owner before implementation.

scenarios.given: a plugin server with a registered workspace
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: exactly the four harness names appear beside the existing plugin tools and every other harness command is refused as unknown.
scenarios.when: tools are listed and other harness command names are called

requirements.text: Exact tool set. Exactly four harness tools (harness-capabilities, harness-registry-status, harness-evaluation-summary, harness-evidence) map to the CLI views; no other harness command is reachable over MCP.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: no file changes, no subprocess, no socket, and executionAuthorization is exactly false.
scenarios.when: called under a write monitor with network and subprocess creation denied

requirements.text: No authority and no effects. Every result carries executionAuthorization false; calls write nothing, lock nothing, read no clock, host, model or network, launch nothing and never promote, activate or grant.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: schemas are flat with the stated properties, descriptions embed the contract schema text and stay within 2,048 bytes.

requirements.text: Trivial flat arguments with the schema in the description, at most 2,048 bytes per description.

scenarios.given: absolute, dot-dot, symlinked, special, missing and outside paths
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: each refuses and the missing, link, special and outside refusals are byte-identical.

requirements.text: Workspace-bound paths resolved under the registered source root without following links; missing, link, special and outside cases refuse identically.

scenarios.given: the SPEC-049 T009 fixtures and negative controls
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: view objects and reason codes are equal.
scenarios.when: each runs through the CLI and the MCP tool

requirements.text: CLI parity. A successful result's view equals the CLI stdout object minus status and executionAuthorization; refusals carry the CLI reason code.

scenarios.given: inputs at, under and over each bound
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: results under the cap succeed and over it refuse with output-too-large; nothing is truncated.

requirements.text: Bounded output. CLI input bounds kept; serialized results at most 65,536 bytes, larger ones refused with output-too-large, never truncated.

scenarios.given: malformed arguments and semantically invalid inputs
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: each refusal has the expected pointer and code, echoes no value and is at most 1,024 characters.

requirements.text: Refusals with an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, fixed reason codes, no echoed values, digested unknown keys, at most 1,024 characters.

scenarios.given: a held-out set frozen by hash before any run
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: per-host validity with Wilson 95% intervals, per-prompt outcomes and failure signatures are recorded; misses are reported as negative results.
scenarios.when: 10 prompts x 3 repetitions run per host with the automated driver

requirements.text: Held-out host validity in Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode before publication: per host at least 8/10 prompts valid at first attempt and 10/10 within one refusal-guided retry, unless revised under OD-2.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: it cites each condition's evidence and a failing condition yields not published.

requirements.text: Conditional publication: only with SPEC-049 T014 results, a D7 outcome that does not close the harness as experimental, REQ-009 passed, the Codex review resolved and owner acceptance; otherwise a recorded no-publish outcome.

scenarios.given: the implemented candidate and both tool listings
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the portable listing equals its v0.2 tool set and no host instruction, configuration, permission or HARNESSING.md claim file changed.
scenarios.when: the candidate diff and the listings are inspected

requirements.text: Surfaces and configuration left untouched. The four tools are plugin-owned and are not added to the portable agent-braid-tooling server; global host instructions, host configuration, host permissions and docs/tooling/HARNESSING.md claims are not changed before publication.

scenarios.given: workspace-relative paths, sha256 values and every refusal path
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: no result contains a submitted value, an absolute host path or contents outside the view fields.

requirements.text: Results carry no submitted values or host paths. No result, success or refusal, contains a submitted argument value, an absolute host path or file contents beyond the CLI view's own fields.

scenarios.given: a host that approved the tool call
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the result keeps executionAuthorization false and the call has no effect.

requirements.text: Host approval grants nothing. Host tool approval does not change any invariant of the contract: no effect, no authority, same tool set.

scientific_limits: H1 (trivial arguments reach the D4 validity target on all three hosts) is a hypothesis REQ-009 may refute. Three hosts with one model each; validity results are descriptive. A Codex review is independent model review, not human review or approval.
scope: Draft versioned read-only MCP contract agent-braid-harness-mcp/v0.1 exposing the four SPEC-049 T009 harness CLI views through the native plugin facade, its versioning decision, held-out host validity test and conditional publication gate. Contract only: no implementation, no publication, no native execution.
